evidence.title: Turner tops out Aligned Data Centers IAD-06 in Frederick, Maryland
evidence.excerpt: Turner reports topping out Aligned Data Centers IAD-06 in Frederick, Maryland, completing the structural phase of a two-story, 450,000-square-foot facility described with an untyped 72 MW figure.
